# Map the surface of this codebase

I inherited this service and I have no idea what is in it. Before I touch anything I want the
lay of the land, not a deep dive.

Give me:

- the folder structure and what each top-level directory is for
- which languages and frameworks it uses, and the versions, from the config files
- the package manager
- where the application actually starts — the entry points
- anything that hints at a database
- what test framework it uses, if any

Write it up as an inventory I can read in one sitting.
